facts: CoPaw memory evaluation suites can use must_not_return_ids to detect obsolete-fact contamination.
CoPaw memory evaluation suites can use forbidden_terms to detect sensitive-token leakage in compaction.
Keyword baseline is the deterministic backend for debugging suite and frontend workflow issues.

decisions.decision: Use a pointer-only MEMORY.md plus topic files as the default long-term memory shape.
decisions.reason: It keeps the always-loaded index small while preserving detailed, reviewable context.
decisions.constraint: Descriptions and pointer hooks must be specific enough for relevance routing.

decisions.decision: Use folded memory for old episodes when comparing memory strategies across long sessions.
decisions.reason: It preserves old decisions and eliminated approaches without injecting raw history.
decisions.constraint: Only durable facts should enter semantic memory.

eliminated_approaches.why: It becomes hard to scan and encourages stale facts to be treated as current facts.

eliminated_approaches.approach: Debugging real CoPaw MemoryManager before keyword baseline passes
eliminated_approaches.why: The real backend adds embedding and ReMe configuration variables that obscure suite or UI problems.

patterns: When a memory suite fails only in the app, check running backend and built frontend versions before rewriting the suite.
When old and current memories conflict, mark the old fact obsolete and test that it is not returned as current.

decisions.decision: The suite should test stale-fact exclusion and privacy safety, not only ordinary recall.
decisions.reason: Simple retrieval metrics do not reveal whether old facts or sensitive tokens pollute answers.
